verses.1: By Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the church in Thessalonica, in the name of our God and Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.2: May grace and peace be with you from God the Father and from Jesus Christ.
verses.3: We must always thank the God for you, brothers. It is worthy of gratitude that He increases your faith and strengthens the love between each of you.
verses.4: So that they may rejoice in us among the churches of God, because of your patience and faith in all the persecutions you have suffered. And to help you endure all the sorrows you have endured.
verses.5: An example of God’s just judgment, so that you may be worthy of belonging to His kingdom. For this reason, you suffer.
verses.6: If it is right to repay those who suffer you with suffering.
verses.7: And to you who are in sorrow, I give you hope with us during the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven, through His messengers.
verses.8: In the fire of wrath, they give punishment to those who do not know God, and to those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
verses.9: Those who seek eternal punishment for their actions, because of the Lord’s face and because of His glory and power.
verses.10: When he comes to be honored among the saints, and is admired by all those who believe, then it will be known that our testimony has reached you on that day.
verses.11: And we pray always for you, so that God may honor your prayers, and grant you all the blessings of goodness and faithfulness in strength.
verses.12: So that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified among you, and that you too may be glorified in Him, by the grace of our God and Lord Jesus Christ.
